scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 80 km this is Grand Tour of Switzerland, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-from-the-great-saltworks-of-salin.story: 327 km from Salins-les-Bains to Salins-les-Bains, about 5 h 38 of riding. On the way it passes Baie de Clendy, Littoral de Chens-sur-Léman and back through Baie de Clendy. The highest point is about 1,000 m. It crosses from France into Switzerland - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
